en-US.title: "Nowhere to dump our trash": The current state of Bali, where waste is piling up on roads, in the...
en-US.description:
Has anyone been to Bali recently? You were probably shocked to see piles of trash everywhere on the streets. Currently, a significant amount of garbage in Bali has nowhere to go as the country's largest landfill has decided to stop accepting organic waste, such as food waste. As a result, the situation has become one where people are illegally dumping waste on roadsides, in the sea, and into rivers, and even secretly burning it at home.

id.description:
Apakah ada yang baru-baru ini mengunjungi Bali? Anda mungkin terkejut melihat tumpukan sampah di mana-mana di jalanan. Saat ini, sejumlah besar sampah di Bali tidak memiliki tempat pembuangan karena tempat pembuangan sampah terbesar di negara itu telah memutuskan untuk berhenti menerima sampah organik, seperti sisa makanan. snippet.title: 중국 일대일로의 핵심 국가 '파키스탄'이 미국 이란 전쟁의 중재국이 된 이유 / 14F
snippet.description:
*해당 영상은 4월 30일 촬영됐습니다.
미국과 이란 간의 전쟁이 벌써 두 달을 넘어가고 있습니다. 중동에서 시작된 불씨는 이제 전 세계의 일상을 뒤흔들고 있는데요. 이런 상황에서 의외의 국가가 중재자로 나섰습니다. 바로 파키스탄이죠. 파키스탄은 IMF 국제 금융에 의존하는 경제 위기 국가 불안정한 핵 보유국이라 불려왔는데요. 지금은 워싱턴과 테이란 사이를 오가면서 중재자로서의 입지를 확대하고 있습니다. 그렇다면 파키스탄은 왜 두 국가 사이에 서게 됐을까요? 오늘은 파키스탄이 중재국으로 나서게 된 배경과 그 이면에 대해 김찬완 한국외대 국제지역대학원장과 함께 알아봤습니다. 

#중동 #이란 #파키스탄

en-US.title: Why 'Pakistan,' a Key Country in China's Belt and Road Initiative, Became the Mediator in the US-...
en-US.description:
*This video was filmed on April 30.

The war between the United States and Iran has already lasted over two months. The sparks that began in the Middle East are now shaking daily life around the world. In this situation, an unexpected country has stepped forward as a mediator: Pakistan. Pakistan has long been described as an economically troubled nation dependent on the IMF for international finance and an unstable nuclear power. However, it is now expanding its standing as a mediator by moving back and forth between Washington and Iran. So, why has Pakistan come to stand between the two nations? Today, we explored the background and underlying reasons behind Pakistan's emergence as a mediator with Kim Chan-wan, Dean of the Graduate School of International Studies at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies.
